title: Using Embedding Models to Improve Probabilistic Race Prediction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating precision-recall performance, Brier scores, and calibration of race prediction models (BISG and embedding-based alternatives) across different self-reported racial categories using ground-truth data from state voter registration files.

Analyzing the correlation between model misclassification (measured via Brier scores) and neighborhood socioeconomic characteristics by comparing prediction quality across census tract-level median household income deciles.
